A controlled tab strip built on {@link TabButton}. Defaults to the `underline` variant — the row carries a bottom border and the active tab's underline overlaps it. Render the matching panel yourself based on `value`.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layout/Tabs.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Tabs } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/components";
```
